summary: An on/off switch for one setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and its accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from naming the inner control. Names the setting, never the state.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when other visible text in the row names the setting.

description.note: Help text under the label, part of the accessible description.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission (SB-0009).

size.note: Track 32x20 (default) or 24x16 (sm). Label typography does not change.

name.note: Form field name. Without it nothing is submitted.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on; nothing is submitted while off (like a native checkbox).

checked.note: On state. The property is the current state and is not reflected; the attribute is the default state that form reset restores.

required.note: Must be on for the form to submit (native valueMissing). Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Not focusable, cannot be toggled, dimmed, not submitted. A disabled fieldset ancestor has the same effect without changing this attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: switch in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Holds the track and thumb over the native input; sized by size.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: The focusable on/off control with the switch role; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.notes: Decorative pill-shaped track; fill shows the state (input color off, primary on).

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Decorative round knob inset 2px in the track; at the start edge when off, the end edge when on (mirrored in right-to-left).

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Label in the same root as the input; clicking it toggles the switch.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle by the person. Not fired when checked is set from code.

change.note: Toggle committed by the person; re-dispatched from the host so it crosses the shadow boundary. Read the new state from checked. Not fired when checked is set from code. FormData read in a listener already holds the new value.

hover.trigger: pointer over an enabled switch or its label
hover.note: No color change, as in the visual reference; the pointer cursor is the hover cue.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb moves to the end edge: state is shown by position as well as color (WCAG 1.4.1).

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt
invalid.note: The track gets a destructive border and the error text shows.

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor
disabled.note: Switch and label dimmed, not-allowed cursor.

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a label element in the same shadow root as the input. Host aria-label is forwarded; aria-labelledby and aria-describedby are not, because ID references do not resolve across shadow roots (SB-0009).

formAssociation.note: Form-associated custom element: submits value under name only while on; form reset restores the checked attribute (default) state; a disabled fieldset ancestor disables it and it is then not submitted; validity mirrored from the inner control (required and off -> valueMissing, error -> customError); form state restore restores on/off; <label for> pointing at the host toggles it.

accessibility.targetSize: The default track is 32x20 and sm 24x16; the label is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception. With hide-label the target is the track alone, so sm with hide-label is discouraged.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus only; 3px solid ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once per element, when label is empty and there is no aria-label.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the owning form (implicit submission, like a native checkbox; the component calls requestSubmit because the inner control has no form owner, SB-0009). It does not toggle.

aria: role=switch on the native checkbox input; the on/off state is exposed as aria-checked by the platform (APG switch pattern)
the label names the setting and does not change with the state
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required on the input; the asterisk is aria-hidden
disabled: native disabled on the input
announcements: on/off state announced by the switch role on toggle
error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: One setting that is on or off, such as enabling notifications
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting

useCases.when: The consequence of turning it on needs explaining
Dense settings lists, table rows or toolbars
A setting that must be on before the form can be submitted
useCases.use: required, with a label stating what is being enabled

antiPatterns.pattern: Changing the label with the state ("On" / "Off")
antiPatterns.why: The switch role already announces on/off; a label that changes reads as a second, conflicting state
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label naming the setting

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for a choice that is only applied after an extra confirmation, or for agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as a setting that is simply on or off; an agreement or a selection among options reads as a checkbox

antiPatterns.pattern: Several switches for mutually exclusive options
antiPatterns.why: Switches are independent; nothing turns the others off

antiPatterns.pattern: Toggle (pressed button) for a setting saved with a form
antiPatterns.why: A toggle button submits no value

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: the visual reference composes Field and Label parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
the visual reference uses ring/50, below 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)
the visual reference's input color is neutral-200, below 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)
the visual reference uses 18.4px (1.15rem) and 14px; rounded to the spacing grid so the 16px and 12px thumbs sit with a 2px inset

drift.contract: destructive track border and error text
drift.realization: the visual reference has no built-in error; it comes from the Field around it
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes: APG switch pattern for keyboard and ARIA, the visual reference for look and sizes, Checkbox as the sibling for the form and field API.
openQuestions.answer: Yes. APG switch pattern; visual reference Switch (sizes default and sm); field API mirrors Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Native input with role=switch, or a button with role=switch and aria-checked?
openQuestions.recommendation: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch>: native Space handling, required/valueMissing validity and label activation come for free, and the shared NativeControl mixin already wraps it.
openQuestions.answer: Native checkbox input with role=switch (recommendation; SB-0007 native first).

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional) or submit the form?
openQuestions.recommendation: Submit the form, like a native checkbox and like Checkbox (SB-0009); Space is the toggle key. Enter toggling would make it the one form control where Enter does not submit.
openQuestions.answer: Enter submits the owning form; Space toggles.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.recommendation: No, like Checkbox: the attribute is the default restored by form reset (native defaultChecked).
openQuestions.answer: Not reflected; the attribute is the reset default.

openQuestions.question: Prop names: canonical vocabulary (selected, errorMessage, size small/medium) or the sibling names (checked, error, size default/sm)?
openQuestions.recommendation: The sibling names, through the aliases already registered in spec/api.json: one spelling across Checkbox and Switch; both move together when the form controls migrate to the canonical names.

openQuestions.question: Where does the label sit: after the switch or before it (settings-row style, switch at the end)?
openQuestions.recommendation: After the switch, like Checkbox and the visual reference's example; a settings row with the switch at the end is a layout built with Item or Field, not a prop.
openQuestions.answer: Switch first, label beside it; no position prop.

openQuestions.question: Track height: the visual reference's 18.4px or the 20px size.switch token?
openQuestions.recommendation: 20px / 16px from the existing size.switch semantic tokens, so the thumb (16px / 12px icon sizes) sits on the 2px inset without fractional pixels; logged as drift.

openQuestions.question: Manual screen-reader pass (VoiceOver, NVDA) of the on/off announcement and the error live region before stable.
